findings.claim: Fast increment 1 still uses npm and the Vitest test workflow before either is taught. T0 tells an FT12 learner to run npm ci and npm test and interpret named test failures while explicitly saying npm is taught on FT13; Vitest is not taught until FT15. Labeling this procedural list Teach-then-check does not supply the plan's promised rule, worked example, quick check, or earlier page section, so the first increment's feedback loop depends on untaught tooling even though the plan says every applied concept is taught first.
findings.recommendation: Add a minimal FT12 orientation immediately before the commands that explains what npm ci and npm test do, shows the expected failing-test shape, checks that the learner can identify the failing outcome, and points to the later full npm/Vitest topics; rebalance the 70-minute increment without removing a frozen topic or block. Alternatively, provide an already-taught launcher for increment 1 while retaining npm test as the lab's declared language-native command.
